meta.label: Slack Incoming Webhooks
meta.description: Slack incoming webhooks — credentials live in the URL path, no header auth

variables.team: Workspace token segment of the webhook URL (starts with T), e.g. T012AB3CD
variables.bot: Channel/bot segment of the webhook URL (starts with B), e.g. B01EF2GH3
variables.secret: Final secret path segment of the webhook URL — the credential itself
